title: Club Registration Checklist
subtitle: Capture club placement, sponsor route, meeting schedule, and participation need; confirm dismissal and membership review.
description: Club Registration records club placement, sponsor route, meeting schedule, participation need, dismissal, and membership review. Club Registration evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this club registration stage-gated verification when staff must document club placement and sponsor route. Reconcile meeting schedule, participation need, dismissal, and membership review before the club registration handoff. Use the membership request, capacity roster, sponsor confirmation, meeting schedule, support-routing acknowledgment, dismissal choice, and welcome-message receipt. This registration establishes recurring membership, sponsor governance, meeting cadence, student eligibility, dues handling, after-meeting dismissal, and membership renewal. Ask the assigned club registration reviewer to confirm club placement against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Club Registration starting details review
sections.guidance: Confirm club capacity, sponsor contact, meeting calendar, participation support, dismissal arrangement, member choice, and first-meeting instructions.

sections.title: Club Registration checks and corrections
sections.guidance: Check current club registration facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Club Registration required checks
items: Club placement is identified for this record
Sponsor route matches the current request or source
Meeting schedule is ready for point-of-use staff
Participation need limits or questions are resolved
Dismissal is communicated to the responsible person
Membership review is confirmed at handoff
A changed club registration fact is returned for review

blocks.label: Club Registration failed or pending items

sections.title: Club Registration readiness
sections.guidance: Hold club registration readiness on any failed or pending item.

blocks.label: Club Registration reviewer receipt

fields.label: Responsible teacher or program coordinator and date

blocks.guidance: Club Registration receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
